THIS ZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the 19* day of March, 2012, by and between 246 EQUITIES, L.L.C., a New York limited liability company, having an office at 37 West 65* Street, 2"d Floor, New York, New York 10023 ("Owner"), and 110 MANHATTAN EQUITIES LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 37 West 65* Street, 2"d Floor, New York, New York 10023 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known and designated as Lot 3 in Block 1846 on the Municipal Tax Map of the City of New York, and known as and by the street address of 246 Manhattan Avenue, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit “A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the building located thereon is herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of certain vacant land located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known and designated as Lot 1 in Block 1846 on the Municipal Tax Map of the City of New York, and known as and by the street address of 240 Manhattan Avenue, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Developer Land"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct a new building, all or a portion of which will be on the Developer Land and to construct other improvements associated with such new building (the new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Building"'; and the Developer Land and the Developer Building, as the case may be, are herein collectively referred to as the "DeveloperParcel"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the Owner Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the Developer Parcel and any Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the Developer Building will contain more floor area than is now available for use on the Developer Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for the Merged Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) so as to make available the Excess Development Rights for utilization in connection with the construction and maintenance of the {00670423;2} 2
